title: How to Calculate Federal Income Tax 2024 - Complete Guide
excerpt: Learn how to calculate your federal income tax for 2024 using IRS brackets. Includes step-by-step guide for filing taxes in 2025.
content:
Understanding how to calculate your federal income tax is essential for every American taxpayer. The US uses a progressive tax system with seven tax brackets ranging from 10% to 37%.

## 2024 Federal Tax Brackets

For the 2024 tax year (which you file in 2025), the tax brackets are:

- 10%: $0 - $11,600 (Single)
- 12%: $11,601 - $47,150
- 22%: $47,151 - $100,525
- 24%: $100,526 - $191,950
- 32%: $191,951 - $243,725
- 35%: $243,726 - $609,350
- 37%: Over $609,350

## Standard Deduction

Most taxpayers should take the standard deduction:
- Single: $14,600
- Married Filing Jointly: $29,200

## How to Calculate

1. Start with your gross income
2. Subtract adjustments to get AGI
3. Subtract standard or itemized deductions
4. Apply the tax brackets to your taxable income
